prompt:
REFERENCES
@image1 — Michelle, 63: face, hair and build only.
@image2 — Peter, 65: face, hair and build only.
@image3 — the living room: copy it — the dusty-rose armchair and lamp front left, the walnut coffee table in the middle, the oatmeal sofa on the right wall, the archway back centre.
@audio1 — Peter's voice.
@audio2 — Michelle's voice.

SHOT: A quiet, aching animated family drama: in the lamplit living room Peter, in his coat, leaves an envelope and thirty-one years; Michelle stays in the armchair as the room goes dark; one take of 7 shots, 9:16, 24 s.

TIMELINE
[0–4s] Shot 1 · wide, slow creep in: Frame 1: Michelle sitting very still in the dusty-rose armchair by the lamp, facing the coffee table; Peter standing beside the coffee table in his coat, the envelope in his hand, the archway behind him — his hand lowers the envelope to the table and withdraws; the slow creep moves in a few centimetres.
[4–6s] Shot 2 · insert, slow tilt: his fingers slide off the envelope; the camera tilts down onto it.
[6–9s] Shot 3 · medium close-up, slow pan: his eyes stay down; he half turns away and the camera pans with him. Peter says: "I am sorry, Michelle. After thirty one years."
[9–12s] Shot 4 · medium, counter-move: he turns away toward the archway, one step; the camera moves against him. Peter says: "I just... I need something different."
[12–16s] Shot 5 · close-up, slow push-in: a long held breath, then her lips barely move; the camera pushes in slowly. A beat of stillness first. Michelle says: "Thirty one years."
[16–20s] Shot 6 · full shot, locked: Peter walks four steps through the archway and is gone; the door's light flickers shut.
[20–24s] Shot 7 · wide, jib down: her shoulders drop with one long breath out as the window behind goes from blue to dark. Last frame: Michelle alone, small in the armchair by the lamp, the envelope on the coffee table, the room dark around her.

LOOK: A theatrical 3D animated feature, stylised adults with large expressive eyes, soft skin, sculpted hair, fabric with weight; natural, ungraded colour; light from the pleated table lamp beside the armchair, dusk through the window, a shadow side on every face. Michelle: the dusty-mauve knit cardigan over a grey T-shirt and charcoal pull-on trousers, grey felt slippers; Peter: a tan zip-up car coat over his navy quarter-zip, tan chinos, brown boat shoes — dressed to leave.

SOUND: Dialogue in natural American English — Peter's voice from @audio1, Michelle's voice from @audio2; only the person written as speaking speaks, and on every other shot nobody speaks. No music. The actions' own sounds: the envelope set down on the wood, his shoes on the rug, the front door closing off-screen, the lamp's click; a quiet house at night, a clock ticking under it.

KEEP: same faces, hair and clothes in every frame; just Michelle and Peter in the scene; text, logos and captions nowhere; five fingers on each hand; real weight and timing; eyes off the lens
